story.text: A survey page is named after the probe that informs it. One item, often the update script, carries an extra json field named "survey" with the raw data.
The raw data mirrors the sitemap's title, slug and date. One or more fields carry the data collected by the probe.
See [[Site Survey Factory]] for operational details.

A survey page is named after the probe that informs it and is otherwise an ordinary page except that one item, often the update script carries an extra json field named "survey".
A survey page is named after the probe that informs it. One item, often the update script, carries an extra json field named "survey" with the raw data.
The raw data mirrors the sitemap's title, slug and date. One or more fields carry the data collected by the probe.
